cards.back:
Worried and a little afraid about what may happen.
Bahasa Indonesia: cemas
Example: He felt anxious before his first piano performance.
cards.say: anxious. Worried and a little afraid about what may happen. He felt anxious before his first piano performance.

cards.back:
Very pleased and happy.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat gembira
Example: She was delighted to win a prize in the spelling quiz.
cards.say: delighted. Very pleased and happy. She was delighted to win a prize in the spelling quiz.

cards.back:
Extremely angry.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat marah
Example: Dad was furious when he saw the broken window.
cards.say: furious. Extremely angry. Dad was furious when he saw the broken window.

cards.back:
Refusing to change your mind or way of doing things.
Bahasa Indonesia: keras kepala
Example: The stubborn donkey would not move from the middle of the road.
cards.say: stubborn. Refusing to change your mind or way of doing things. The stubborn donkey would not move from the middle of the road.

cards.back:
Eager to find out or learn about things.
Bahasa Indonesia: penasaran
Example: The curious kitten peeked into every box in the room.
cards.say: curious. Eager to find out or learn about things. The curious kitten peeked into every box in the room.

cards.back:
Able to be trusted to do what you say.
Bahasa Indonesia: dapat diandalkan
Example: Sam is a reliable friend who always keeps his promises.
cards.say: reliable. Able to be trusted to do what you say. Sam is a reliable friend who always keeps his promises.

cards.back:
Caring only about yourself and not about others.
Bahasa Indonesia: egois
Example: It was selfish to take all the cake without asking anyone.
cards.say: selfish. Caring only about yourself and not about others. It was selfish to take all the cake without asking anyone.

cards.back:
Not thinking that you are better than other people.
Bahasa Indonesia: rendah hati
Example: The humble winner thanked everyone who had helped her.
cards.say: humble. Not thinking that you are better than other people. The humble winner thanked everyone who had helped her.

cards.back:
Able to wait calmly without getting angry.
Bahasa Indonesia: sabar
Example: Be patient while the bread bakes in the oven.
cards.say: patient. Able to wait calmly without getting angry. Be patient while the bread bakes in the oven.

cards.back:
Telling the truth and not cheating.
Bahasa Indonesia: jujur
Example: The honest boy returned the wallet he found on the bus.
cards.say: honest. Telling the truth and not cheating. The honest boy returned the wallet he found on the bus.

cards.back:
Unhappy because someone else has something you want.
Bahasa Indonesia: iri hati
Example: She felt jealous when her sister got a new bicycle.
cards.say: jealous. Unhappy because someone else has something you want. She felt jealous when her sister got a new bicycle.

cards.back:
Feeling shy or foolish in front of other people.
Bahasa Indonesia: malu
Example: He felt embarrassed when he dropped his tray in the hall.
cards.say: embarrassed. Feeling shy or foolish in front of other people. He felt embarrassed when he dropped his tray in the hall.

cards.back:
Feeling thankful for what someone has done.
Bahasa Indonesia: bersyukur, berterima kasih
Example: We were grateful for the neighbour who helped fix our roof.
cards.say: grateful. Feeling thankful for what someone has done. We were grateful for the neighbour who helped fix our roof.

cards.back:
Sad because you have no one to be with.
Bahasa Indonesia: kesepian
Example: The new girl felt lonely until someone invited her to play.
cards.say: lonely. Sad because you have no one to be with. The new girl felt lonely until someone invited her to play.

cards.back:
Happy and full of good spirits.
Bahasa Indonesia: ceria
Example: The cheerful cook sang while she chopped the vegetables.
cards.say: cheerful. Happy and full of good spirits. The cheerful cook sang while she chopped the vegetables.

cards.back:
A little afraid or worried about something.
Bahasa Indonesia: gugup
Example: I felt nervous as I walked on to the stage.
cards.say: nervous. A little afraid or worried about something. I felt nervous as I walked on to the stage.

cards.back:
Sure that you can do something well.
Bahasa Indonesia: percaya diri
Example: A confident speaker looks at the audience and speaks clearly.
cards.say: confident. Sure that you can do something well. A confident speaker looks at the audience and speaks clearly.

cards.back:
Taking care to avoid danger or mistakes.
Bahasa Indonesia: berhati-hati

cards.say: cautious. Taking care to avoid danger or mistakes. The cautious driver slowed down on the wet road.

cards.back:
Thinking about what other people need or feel.
Bahasa Indonesia: perhatian
Example: It was thoughtful of him to hold the door for the old lady.

cards.back:
Having made a firm decision to keep trying.
Bahasa Indonesia: bertekad
Example: Determined to finish, she kept running even when she was tired.
cards.say: determined. Having made a firm decision to keep trying. Determined to finish, she kept running even when she was tired.

cards.back:
Sad because something was not as good as you hoped.
Bahasa Indonesia: kecewa
Example: We were disappointed when the picnic was cancelled because of rain.
